title: Do I need travel insurance?

post.title: Do I need travel insurance?
post.html: We strongly recommend taking out travel insurance, including cancellation cover, at the time you book. This protects you should something unforeseen, such as illness, prevent you from travelling, as any refund for a cancellation is at our discretion.

description: We strongly recommend travel insurance with cancellation cover when you book, as any refund for a cancellation is at our discretion.
